responsibility: This file lowers function calls from tree/RTL-expander inputs into ABI-correct RTL call sequences. It is the core call-expansion implementation for argument classification, register-versus-stack placement, outgoing stack layout, sibling and tail-call viability checks, by-value and variable-size argument handling, call sequence emission, and related target hook interactions for calling conventions, consuming function_arg_info and call flags and producing CALL_INSNs plus the necessary argument moves, stack adjustments, and return-value setup.
same_name_distinction: Implementation file in the `calls` group: it realizes ABI-aware call lowering, argument placement, stack/register setup, and sibling-call handling, whereas `gcc/calls.h` only defines `function_arg_info` and declares the call-expansion interface used by other expanders.
